# Lint Rules

`fobis lint` has 33 rules. Rules marked *default* run unless a selection is given;
*opt-in* rules run only when selected (`--select COR003`, a prefix like `--select COR`, or `ALL`).
Run `fobis lint --explain <ID>` for the same documentation in the terminal. How to run, select and
suppress rules: [Linting](/ai/lint).

## Correctness (`COR`)

| Rule | Name | Severity | Default | Fortitude | Reports |
|------|------|----------|---------|-----------|---------|
| [COR001](/lint-rules/COR001) | `implicit-typing` | warning | yes | C001 | A module, program or external procedure has no `implicit none`. |
| [COR002](/lint-rules/COR002) | `interface-implicit-typing` | warning | yes | C002 | An interface body has no `implicit none`. |
| [COR003](/lint-rules/COR003) | `implicit-external-procedures` | warning | opt-in | C003 | `implicit none` does not forbid implicit external procedures (`implicit none (type, external)`). |
| [COR010](/lint-rules/COR010) | `missing-intent` | warning | yes | C061 | A dummy argument has no `intent`. |
| [COR011](/lint-rules/COR011) | `assumed-size` | warning | yes | C071 | A dummy array is assumed-size (`a(*)`, `a(n,*)`). |
| [COR020](/lint-rules/COR020) | `initialisation-in-declaration` | warning | yes | C081 | A procedure's local variable is initialised in its declaration, which implies `save`. |
| [COR021](/lint-rules/COR021) | `pointer-initialisation-in-declaration` | warning | yes | C082 | A procedure's local pointer is initialised in its declaration (`=> null()`), which implies `save`. |
| [COR030](/lint-rules/COR030) | `external-procedure` | warning | yes | C091 | A procedure is declared `external`. |
| [COR031](/lint-rules/COR031) | `procedure-not-in-module` | warning | yes | C092 | A subroutine or function is defined outside a module (an external procedure). |
| [COR040](/lint-rules/COR040) | `use-all` | warning | yes | C121 | A `use` statement imports everything (no `only:` list). |
| [COR041](/lint-rules/COR041) | `missing-intrinsic` | warning | yes | C122 | An intrinsic module is used without the `intrinsic` keyword. |
| [COR050](/lint-rules/COR050) | `missing-accessibility-statement` | warning | yes | C131 | A module has no default accessibility statement (`private` or `public`). |
| [COR060](/lint-rules/COR060) | `unchecked-stat` | warning | yes | C181 | The `stat=` variable of an `allocate`/`deallocate` is never read afterwards. |
| [COR061](/lint-rules/COR061) | `multiple-allocations-with-stat` | warning | yes | C182 | One `allocate`/`deallocate` with `stat=` handles several objects. |

## Obsolescent (`OBS`)

| Rule | Name | Severity | Default | Fortitude | Reports |
|------|------|----------|---------|-----------|---------|
| [OBS001](/lint-rules/OBS001) | `common-block` | warning | yes | OB011 | A `common` block. |
| [OBS002](/lint-rules/OBS002) | `equivalence-statement` | warning | yes | OB012 | An `equivalence` statement. |
| [OBS003](/lint-rules/OBS003) | `block-data` | warning | yes | OB013 | A `block data` program unit. |
| [OBS004](/lint-rules/OBS004) | `entry-statement` | warning | yes | OB021 | An `entry` statement. |
| [OBS005](/lint-rules/OBS005) | `specific-intrinsic-name` | warning | yes | OB031 | A specific intrinsic name (`dsqrt`, `dabs`, `amax1`, `float` ...) instead of the generic one. |
| [OBS006](/lint-rules/OBS006) | `computed-go-to` | warning | yes | OB041 | A computed `go to (l1, l2, ...), i`. |
| [OBS007](/lint-rules/OBS007) | `pause-statement` | warning | yes | OB051 | A `pause` statement. |
| [OBS008](/lint-rules/OBS008) | `deprecated-character-syntax` | warning | yes | OB061 | Old-style character length `character*n` / `character*(*)`. |
| [OBS009](/lint-rules/OBS009) | `forall` | warning | yes | OB071 | A `forall` statement or construct. |
| [OBS010](/lint-rules/OBS010) | `arithmetic-if` | warning | yes | OB081 | An arithmetic `if (x) l1, l2, l3`. |
| [OBS011](/lint-rules/OBS011) | `labelled-do-loop` | warning | yes | OB091 | A labelled `do 10 i = ...` loop. |
| [OBS012](/lint-rules/OBS012) | `shared-do-termination` | warning | yes | OB092 | Several `do` loops end on the same labelled statement. |
| [OBS013](/lint-rules/OBS013) | `bad-do-termination` | warning | yes | OB093 | A labelled `do` loop ends on a statement other than `continue` or `end do`. |
| [OBS020](/lint-rules/OBS020) | `deprecated-mpi-include` | warning | yes | OB201 | `include 'mpif.h'` instead of the `mpi_f08` module. |
| [OBS021](/lint-rules/OBS021) | `deprecated-omp-include` | warning | yes | OB211 | `include 'omp_lib.h'` instead of the `omp_lib` module. |

## Linter (`LNT`)

| Rule | Name | Severity | Default | Fortitude | Reports |
|------|------|----------|---------|-----------|---------|
| [LNT001](/lint-rules/LNT001) | `suppression-without-reason` | warning | yes | - | An inline suppression `! fobis: ignore[ID]` gives no reason. |
| [LNT002](/lint-rules/LNT002) | `unused-suppression` | warning | yes | - | An inline suppression silences nothing. |
| [LNT003](/lint-rules/LNT003) | `unknown-rule-in-suppression` | warning | yes | - | An inline suppression names a rule that does not exist. |
| [LNT004](/lint-rules/LNT004) | `preprocessor-assumption` | info | yes | - | A preprocessor condition could not be evaluated and was assumed true. |

## Relation to Fortitude

The generic rules (`COR`, `OBS`) are a native reimplementation, in FoBiS's own words and on its own
source analysis, of rules catalogued by [Fortitude](https://fortitude.readthedocs.io/) (PlasmaFAIR, MIT
licence), whose rule set served as the reference. The *Fortitude* column gives the matching Fortitude
code, for users who know it. FoBiS does not depend on Fortitude.
